question: Does the existing fine R8 operating point meet unchanged stability budgets under rate-grid and absolute-tolerance refinement and repeat exactly across fresh processes?

runs.role: cold repeat of R8 before interventions
tighten HT/MT/LT absolute tolerances tenfold only
cold repeat of F0 after intervening runs

numerical_budget.rationale: One tenth of the corresponding pinned PRIMAT regression tolerances, chosen before observing R1-R8.
numerical_budget.relative_difference_definition: abs(x_run-x_R0)/max(abs(x_run),abs(x_R0),1e-300) for final species; trajectory metric uses the per-species trajectory norm defined in OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md.
numerical_budget.trajectory_metric: For each species, normalize pointwise absolute deviations by max(max_T(abs(Y_R0)), max_T(abs(Y_run)), 1e-30); report per-era maximum, temperature location and both absolute and normalized values. Trajectory metric is diagnostic unless separately thresholded in the preregistration.

upstream_reference_tolerances.source: PRIMAT tests/reference_values.py at the pinned commit

acceptance.repeat: F0 and F_REPEAT raw arrays, traces and scalar outputs bitwise identical; no fit or tolerance relaxation
acceptance.refinement: F_RATE versus F0 and F_ATOL versus F0: same observable budgets as N1
acceptance.parent_environment: F0 versus archived R8 reported separately; all current runs must share target environment
acceptance.scope: Bounded operating-point stability on rate grid and absolute tolerances; not a theorem of asymptotic convergence, independent-solver validation, or S2 discovery
acceptance.stop: Any engineering failure stops further workers and preserves evidence. Numerical fail is reported without automatic retry.

runtime.routing: Whole package >600 s. GitHub Actions VM. Fresh bounded target PROBE uses max rate grid and existing frozen BG8000 to calibrate before strict solves.
